name: A Stack of Letters
summary: A Stack of Letters has come through the mountain pass into Coldridge Valley. The bundle is meant for scouts stationed in the snowy wilderness.

sections.title: Through the Pass
sections.body: Mail for Coldridge Valley comes from Anvilmar by way of travelers crossing the pass. The journey to the remote camps in Dun Morogh's mountains is hard, and postal runners rely on travelers to carry letters onward. This bundle is bound for scouts deeper in Coldridge Valley. Talin Keeneye, at his lakeside camp, is thought to be its only recipient until the letters are sorted. Among them is a missive for Grelin Whitebeard, a mountaineer.

faq.q: What is inside the stack of letters?
faq.answer: The bundle holds personal letters and dispatches for dwarves in Coldridge Valley. Talin Keeneye, at his camp near the frozen lake, is thought to be the only recipient until the letters reveal one addressed to Grelin Whitebeard.

faq.q: Who sends these letters to Coldridge Valley?
aliases: where did the letters come from
faq.answer: The letters came through the pass into Coldridge Valley and reached Anvilmar. From there, a traveler willing to carry them down the road took them onward.
The dwarf scout Talin Keeneye receives the parcel at his camp by the frozen lake. Looking through the stack, he finds a letter for Grelin Whitebeard.

angles.text: As a young mountaineer starting out in Coldridge Valley, carrying mail between snowy camps introduces you to Dun Morogh's harsh roads and scattered watchers.
